### L1 review (#35053) · 2026-11-18T07:32Z

L1: REWORK (one must-fix, the `Clause-②` declaration)
Head-sha: 2e944beb4b64582b92b2cfe642ca60cceb49e937

This is the first L1 on this PR. I read the full diff against the merge-base `958ee03594`: 13 files, +625/−72. I also read the claim 6970395023, the os-dev report 6971765036 and the area's final-head comment 6972122145.

**The fix, read against the card.**
- `referencedRecordTitle(targetDef, record, displayField?)` is `getRecordDisplayName`'s ladder above its floor: the lookup's `displayField`, then the target's declared `nameField` and its aliases, then the name-ish keys. It answers `undefined` instead of `Record #<id>` / `Untitled`. `getRecordDisplayName` now calls the same `recordTitleAboveFloor` and keeps its floor, so its behaviour is unchanged.
- **Server-grouped headers** (`useServerGrouping.ts`): the target definition is read beside the record read (`readLookupTargetDef`, which never rejects), and each key is named by `referencedRecordTitle`. Keys stay ids.
- **Client-grouped headers** (`objectGridGrouping.ts`): `useLookupTargetDefs` reads each lookup target once per content change of the list, keyed on content rather than array identity (`ui/AGENTS.md` #10). It is skipped for a server-grouped fetch. The formatter names an expanded record through `referencedRecordTitle`. Without a definition, `buildSegmentLabel`'s fallback reads the record alone. The ladder's `NAME_ISH_RECORD_KEYS` cover every key the old inline list tried (`name`, `label`, `title`, `display_name`, `displayName`, `fullName`, `full_name`), so nothing a host relied on is lost.
- **Filter value picker** (`filter-builder.tsx`): `useSettledSchema` reads the target definition, and option and chip labels are now derived at render from the held records, so a definition that lands after the search still names them. `displayField` is no longer defaulted to `"name"`, so an explicit one still wins. Values stay ids.
- **Empty group**: `(empty)` becomes `t('grid.empty')`. `compareGroupLabels` places the empty group by its key (first ascending, last descending), where it had sorted by the literal `(` before. Three existing pins move from `'(empty)'` to `'Empty'` with no assertion weakened, and a zh-CN pin reads `空`.

**Shape and scope.**
- `Fixes #35053` is on the first card line, with no closing keyword next to another open card. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.
- Every path is inside the claim's surface. Not governed, below the threshold.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/35053-lookup-label-namefield.md` is new and edits no changeset on main. It bumps `@object-ui/core`, `plugin-grid` and `components` as `patch`. I checked its sentences against the diff:
- "named by the target object's declared `nameField` … An explicit `displayField` on the lookup still wins" matches the CONTROL pins on all three surfaces.
- "Grouping and filtering stay keyed by record id, so two records with the same title stay separate" matches the same-title pin.
- "reads the grid's own empty-value string (`grid.empty`) … keeps its place in the group order: first when ascending and last when descending" matches `compareGroupLabels`.
- "`@object-ui/core` adds `referencedRecordTitle(...)`" is true, and leads to M1.

**Tests and evidence.**
- New pins: server and client `nameField` groups, the `displayField` CONTROL, same-title groups stay two, zh-CN empty reads `空`, the picker's options and chip with a `displayField` CONTROL, and 4 core pins.
- The whole `core`, `plugin-grid` and `components` suites passed: 11,601 tests in 1,017 files. Type-checks are clean.
- Four ablation legs each went red (server 2, client 3, picker 2, empty label 6), with the CONTROLs green, and each was restored to blob == HEAD.

**CI at this head**, read from check-runs (58): 45 success, 13 skipped, none failed, none in progress.

#### Must-fix
- **M1. `Clause-②: no` is wrong: the PR adds a published name to `@object-ui/core`.**
  - `referencedRecordTitle` is exported from `utils/record-title.ts`, which `ui/packages/core/src/index.ts:332` re-exports in full (`export * from './utils/record-title.js'`). It is therefore on the package entry, and the changeset says so itself.
  - The same shape was ruled `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on #35116 (`planObjectFormulas` added to the `@object-ui/core` entry, contract record 6970547337).
  - The line matters beyond the record. `release-github-releases.mjs` sorts a release bullet by its `Clause-②:` arm, so a `yes` lists the bullet under 新增能力, and the `yes` makes a `TIER_DEFAULT` contract record owed (`contract-review.md`), which the final-head comment says is not owed.
  - Fix: set `Clause-②: yes (widening)` in the PR body and in the changeset, and add a claim amendment line on #35053 recording the move from `no` (as #35124 did). Alternatively, make the helper module-internal by not re-exporting it from the entry. The two other packages import it from `@object-ui/core`, though, so that would need a different home.
  - I'll read the body and changeset delta alone. The `TIER_DEFAULT` record then runs in your thread.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### Notes
- **N1.** The `@object-ui/fields` lookup-cell resolver could reuse the helper, and the Acceptance notes record that (no defect, not filed). I agree.
- **N2.** The empty group's English heading changes from `(empty)` to `Empty`. A user's saved group-collapse state is keyed by segment, not by heading, so I expect no state loss. That is my reading of `extractValueKey` / `buildSegmentKey`, not a measurement.
- **Landing.** Owed: M1 and its delta L1, then the `TIER_DEFAULT` contract record.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `861bdd2e4bfbd70774a19a1cf03902e3d511d469`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #35053 (body and all 5 comments: triage 6965529303, claim 6970395023, os-dev-report 6971765036, claim amendment 6972188277, addendum 6972246390), PR #35140 (body, the L1 REWORK 6972149286, the final-head note 6972122145, and the brief 6972264641), the full diff against merge-base `958ee03594` (13 files, +625/−72), the changeset, and the check-runs on this head. Code outside the diff was read at `origin/main` only.

### ① Derived judgments

- **CI on this head is still running.** 59 check-runs: 16 success, 15 skipped, 28 in progress, 0 failure. Still running: `Test UI` (16 shards), `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Type Check · consumer gates` and seven `Lint ·` lanes. I judge on what is complete. The last commit (`2e944beb..861bdd2e`) changes 2 lines of the changeset and no code. On the code-identical head `2e944beb`, all 58 runs finished: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure. The seat must still see this head's runs finish green before landing.
- **Public surface, `@object-ui/core`: widened, right.** The `exports` map has only `.`. `src/index.ts:332` re-exports `./utils/record-title.js` in full, so `referencedRecordTitle(targetDef: any, record: any, displayField?: string): string | undefined` is a new entry member. Its parameters and return reach no new type. `recordTitleAboveFloor` is module-private and not exported. Nothing is removed or renamed.
- **`getRecordDisplayName`: behaviour unchanged, right.** The old body moves verbatim into `recordTitleAboveFloor`. Every early return in it returns a title, and the `Record #id` / `fallback` / `Untitled` floor stays in `getRecordDisplayName` itself. The new core pin asserts `Record #x1` for a record nothing names.
- **Public surface, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: no new export, right.** The entry (`index.tsx`) does not re-export `lookupGroupTargets.ts` (`readLookupTargetDef`, `useLookupTargetDefs`), and `useServerGrouping` and `objectGridGrouping` gain no exported members. Two existing published members change behaviour, but not their signatures:
  - `useGroupedData` (published at `index.tsx:36`), with no formatter, now names an expanded record through `referencedRecordTitle(undefined, value)`. The old order was name, label, title, display_name, displayName, fullName, full_name. The new order is name, full_name, fullName, display_name, displayName, title, subject, label, then the `_name` / `_title` affix scan. So a record with both `label` and `title` is now headed by `title`. A record with only `subject` or an affix key is named instead of showing its id. Nothing that used to be named now falls to its id. See N1.
  - The empty group heading is now `t('grid.empty')`, which is "Empty" with no provider (from the grid's default map) and the pack value under a provider. `createSafeTranslation` works with no provider, so a standalone host of `useGroupedData` does not need a new provider. `compareGroupLabels` keeps the empty group first when ascending and last when descending on the no-ranks path, where the literal used to sort. The ranks path is unchanged (empty is last). Grouping keys are untouched.
- **Public surface, `@object-ui/components`: no change, right.** `LookupValuePicker` is module-internal, and `FilterBuilderProps` and the field shape are unchanged. The `displayField` default moves from `"name"` to the target's ladder, which is the spec's declared default (`field.zod.ts`: "defaults to the referenced object's name/title"). `useSettledSchema` is on `@object-ui/react`'s entry at `main`, and `@object-ui/react` is already a dependency of the package.
- **Write and filter values: unchanged, right.** The server-grouped keys, the client segment keys (`extractValueKey` / `buildSegmentKey`) and the picker's `value` stay record ids. The same-title pin and the picker option pin (the written value is the id) hold this.
- **Accept sets: nothing narrows.** No input a host or author could pass before is refused now. The changes are to output text only: more records are named, and the empty heading is translated.
- **Intra-package version skew: none.** `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/components` import the new core export. Both depend on `@object-ui/core` as `workspace:*`, which publishes as an exact version, and all three move in this changeset.
- **SQL push-down: no finding.** The diff adds no data query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The server-header label read is the existing `find(reference, { $filter: { id: { $in } } })` over the ids the header query already answered. Its new partner is a metadata read (`getObjectSchema`, run in parallel and never rejecting). The client path adds one metadata read per lookup target per change of the target list, and it is skipped when grouping is server-side. The picker adds one per mount, through `useSettledSchema`. The picker's two existing `find` calls are unchanged; it now keeps the records and derives the labels at render.

Findings:

- **N1 (nit) — the changeset does not mention the published `useGroupedData` label change.** The changeset says three places "guessed a `name`, `label` or `title` key". It does not say that the published hook, with no formatter, now uses the record-title ladder: `title` before `label`, plus `subject` and the affix scan. The PR body's Acceptance notes do record it, but the changeset is what ships as `CHANGELOG.md`. One sentence would close it. No correctness or contract effect: it changes output text only, and a record named before is still named.
- **N2 (nit) — two doc comments still say "(empty)".** `GroupRowProps.label` (`GroupRow.tsx:17`, published through `export type { GroupRowProps }`, so it ships in the `.d.ts`) reads `Display label for the group (field value or "(empty)")`. `temporalCellFace.ts:81` says the band keeps `"(empty)" for an empty key`. Both now read `grid.empty`. These are prose only.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset `.changeset/35053-lookup-label-namefield.md`: right.** It bumps `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/components` at `patch`. Those are exactly the three published packages the diff moves; the tests are not published. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist item 3 says that `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`, and that a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. The precedent record 6970547337 (#35116) made the same call for a new `@object-ui/core` export. The addendum notes that `.changeset/34173-…` is no longer in the tree. That does not matter: the rule itself sets the level. CI `Check Changeset` succeeded on this head.
- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: right.** It is line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset, and the arm is from the closed pair. A new member on a package entry is a widening, and the precedent ruled the same shape the same way. The output-text changes in ① are not narrowing: no accepted input is refused. This corrects L1 M1 (6972149286), and claim amendment 6972188277 records the move from `no`.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: right.** No `packages/spec` path is touched, and no authorable key, value or type is added. The spec already declares the default the UI now follows ("the referenced object's name/title"), so this is a consumer catching up to its declared meaning, not a `semantic` change.
- **Changeset prose, checked against the diff: right, except for the omission in N1.**
  - "named by the target object's declared `nameField` … An explicit `displayField` on the lookup still wins": matches `referencedRecordTitle` (step 0 `titleField`, then `declaredNameField`) and the CONTROL pins on all three surfaces.
  - "same title the lookup's grid cell and the record header already show": the cell names through `getRecordDisplayName` on the target definition, which has the same ladder above the floor.
  - "Grouping and filtering stay keyed by record id": true, see ①.
  - "The picker reads the target object's definition once per picker": true, through `useSettledSchema`.
  - "`grid.empty` … first when ascending and last when descending": true for label order, through `compareGroupLabels`. Option-ranked fields keep the empty group last, as before.
  - "adds `referencedRecordTitle(…)` to its public entry, a new export … returns `undefined` instead of the … floor": true.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: `[]` in both reports. Nothing to answer.
- Deviation, origin/main not merged before the PR (base `958ee035`, 5 incoming commits touching none of the diff's files, overlap-check clean): accepted. CI judges the PR on its merge ref, and the queue re-tests in the merge group.
- Deviations, lock exit 99 retaken, and the gate loop run unlocked beside the locked test run: process only, no contract effect. CI answers the same families on the head. Accepted.
- Deviation, the English heading moves from `(empty)` to `Empty` and three pins are updated: answered. The changeset states it ("Empty" in English), the moved pins keep their ascending-order assertions, and no source in `ui/` compares a label to the literal any more. The two stale doc comments are N2.
- Deviation, no doc page for ui commandment #2: answered. `content/docs` mentions an `(empty)` group only in the v17.6 release notes, which are history, not a page to update.
- Addendum deviations (`tsx` missing before `pnpm install` in a fresh worktree; precedent changeset absent): process only. The first is a local prerequisite, and the second is answered in ②.
- Out-of-scope note, `@object-ui/fields`' private `resolveLookupRecordName` could call `referencedRecordTitle`: answered. It is a reuse opportunity, not a defect; the cell already names by the same ladder. L1 N1 agreed. Not filing is correct under the filing gate (no defect, no user effect).
- Mechanism assumption, measured false (no producer held the target definition): answered by the new metadata reads in ①, with the SQL push-down check above. No data-query cost is added.
- Process notes: the claim declared `Clause-②: no`, and amendment 6972188277 moved it to `yes (widening)` before this record. The PR is a draft. Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay), assignee `os-warren`, so no extra author note is owed. The seat must confirm that the 28 in-progress runs finish green on this head before landing (①).
